name: Apple M3 Max (64GB), llama.cpp: Llama-3.3-70B Q4_K_M decode tok/s vs context (Silicon Score measured)
unit: decode tok/s (single-stream, Q4_K_M, 258 ctx) - falls to 6.1 tok/s at 32K ctx
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (Silicon Score Llama 3.3 70B model page + chip rows, cited by research-big-memory.md). M3 Max 64GB, 300-400 GB/s unified memory: 8.2 tok/s at 258-token context falling to 6.1 tok/s at 32K ctx on 70B Q4_K_M. Context length is the binding constraint - the KV cache grows into the same unified pool the weights live in, and decode slows as the working set grows.
notes: Gap-fill for the Oct-14 Phase-A ingest: research-big-memory.md cited this context-dependent row but no dedicated record existed. Value field holds the 258-ctx figure; the 32K-ctx figure (6.1) is in the unit string because the schema metric is a single scalar. Illustrates the 'ctx crushes speed' caveat on 64GB Apple parts - a 70B at long context is a different product than a 70B at 4K.
